newsitem.title: ITALY: Agnelli Jr. no longer Italy's eligible bachelor. [CORRECTED 08:10 GMT 20/10]
newsitem.headline: Agnelli Jr. no longer Italy's eligible bachelor. [CORRECTED 08:10 GMT 20/10]

text.p: Giovanni Alberto Agnelli, the handsome heir to the Fiat car dynasty, is no longer Italy's most eligible banchelor, newspapers reported on Saturday.
"Agnelli Jr is getting married -- to an American," ran a frontpage headline in Milan's Corriere della Sera daily.

They said Agnelli, 32, the nephew and appointed heir of former Fiat chairman Gianni Agnelli, would marry Avery Howe, a 31-year-old architect he met when they were students at Brown University in the United States.

"We've lost our John," said Rome's La Repubblica in a frontpage editorial, referring to John Kennedy Jr., to whom Agnelli bears a striking resemblence and who finally got married last month. (Corrects from "who is also reported to be getting married")
The blonde Howe holds both American and British citizenship, the papers said.
News of the engagement broke out after the couple recently handed in marriage documents at the town hall of Montopoli Val d'Arno, the Tuscan village where Agnelli lives.

The wedding is expected to take place by the end of the year but should be a simple family affair. "Italy's reigning dynasty, the Agnelli family, looks set to celebrate this with a minimum of pomp," La Repubblica said.
